v2.0.3

Patch: identical content to v2.0.2 (matchConditions fix, issue 08) --
v2.0.2's underlying commit was accidentally SSH-signed, which Flux's
go-git library fails to resolve during its shallow-fetch-by-tag path.
Same root cause and fix as v1.0.3 -- see that tag's message.
v2.0.2 stays as an honest record, tag-immutability ruleset blocks moving
it. v2.0.3's commit is unsigned; the tag itself is fully gitsign-signed.
